description: Temporary endpoint containment. Rejects direct-dispatch requests into ConfigEditor under the documented Tapestry route.
affected_versions: PaperCut PaperCut MF/NG: 0 to <24.1.10, 25.0.0 to <25.0.13, 26.0.0 to <26.0.5; verify complete affected/fixed ranges and deployment prerequisites in the linked CNA/vendor records.
coverage: Rejects direct-dispatch requests into ConfigEditor under the documented Tapestry route.
limitations: This contains the selected administrative route, not all authentication-bypass paths. Only the declared request facts and bounded native matcher are covered. No vulnerable-deployment reproduction was performed. Direct-origin access, alternate routes/encodings and uninspectable facts remain outside this rule. Apply vendor fixes; this is not complete CVE protection.
false_positive_risk: Legitimate ConfigEditor direct operations are blocked.
